_comment: Roles for Bob. Copy to roles.json (gitignored, or point BOB_ROLES_FILE at another path) and edit. A chat in chat-config.json gets "role": [...] instead of a hand-written "mcp" list; its access is the union of the roles' "dostep" plus the chat's "dodatkowo" minus its "bez". A chat with "kanal_fr": true never gets a group flagged "tylko_zespol" (team-only). The role "asystent" is required: it means every default group (the old "mcp": null). "wiedza" entries: "wpiecie" is "prompt" (appended to the system prompt of chats with the role), "narzedzie" (read by a tool on request) or "kod" (wired in the code, described here only). "obraz" is a file name from scripts/bob_panel/static/bob/ (without .svg) - the role's picture in the panel. The file is read on every reply, so a change applies immediately.
